articles.title: China Arrests Beijing House Church Pastor As Crackdown On Christians Widens
articles.content:
by Stefan J. Bos, Worthy News Chief International Correspondent

BEIJING, CHINA (Worthy News) – Chinese authorities have arrested the pastor of a prominent independent Protestant church in Beijing on fraud allegations, while seven fellow Christians have been released on bail following a large-scale police raid, church representatives and rights advocates confirmed.

Pastor Cui Xianfeng, also known as Edward Cui, and Zhou Zixun were formally arrested on October 23 after being detained during a September 4 police operation involving more than 100 officers, according to his wife and the Christian rights organization ChinaAid.

Cui remains at Beijing’s Shijingshan District Detention Center, but seven church workers detained in connection with the operation have been released on bail, ChinaAid said in a statement reviewed by Worthy News.

His wife, South Korean national Jin Young Gu, also known as Cui Jinrong or Choi Jinyoung, told The Associated Press (AP) that the fraud allegations concerned donations from members of Beijing Jiaquan Church.

She suggested the charges were connected to the congregation’s refusal to register under China’s government-controlled Protestant religious system. Chinese authorities have not publicly disclosed evidence supporting the accusations.

POLICE RAID BEIJING CHURCH

The confrontation reportedly began on September 4 when about 50 church members were preparing a Beijing hotel conference room for the congregation’s 20th anniversary celebration, and more than 100 officers surrounded the venue.

Seven Christians were detained there and Cui elsewhere. Two were initially released, but police subsequently detained two other church leaders, leaving eight people in custody before seven were eventually freed on bail, Christians said.

Founded in 2006, Jiaquan Church has grown into an independent network serving more than 1,000 believers in several parts of China, according to ChinaAid.

Authorities closed its main Beijing worship facility in 2019, forcing members to gather in smaller groups at different locations, Cui’s wife said.

In 2023, officials interrupted a Sunday church class to warn the couple that their congregation had become too large, Worthy News learned.

PASTOR WARNS OF CHURCH PRESSURE

“They told him that he should lead only one church with fewer than 100 people,” Gu said.

“This was a direct warning from the authorities concerning the size and organization of our church,” she added.

However, Gu stressed that Jiaquan would remain independent, guided by biblical teachings and historical Christian traditions, and had no political ambitions.

Pastor Cui reportedly sent a message from detention urging believers to “hold fast to their faith and never lose hope,” according to ChinaAid.

His wife requested prayers for his health and the seven released coworkers, whom she said had suffered physical and psychological trauma during police interrogation.

CHRISTIAN FAMILY FACES SEPARATION

Gu also reported continued police questioning of other church members, while lawyers were preparing legal proceedings seeking Cui’s release and the eventual acquittal of all eight Christians.

This isn’t the first crisis facing the couple who married in 1997 and studied at Biola University in California before returning to Beijing in late 2005 and establishing Jiaquan Church the following year.

Gu said Chinese authorities had denied her a visa to return to China since 2023, leaving her separated from her husband for about three years.

Police in Beijing’s Shijingshan district did not respond to requests for comment, while China’s Foreign Ministry did not answer questions about the case.

Cui’s arrest follows a sweeping crackdown on Zion Church, another major independent Protestant network, whose leaders were detained during coordinated police raids across several Chinese cities in October 2025, sources said.

CHINA CRACKDOWN ON HOUSE CHURCHES

About 30 Zion Church leaders and members were reportedly detained, including founder Pastor Ezra Jin Mingri, who was released in July 2026 after U.S. President Donald J. Trump raised his detention with Chinese President Xi Jinping during a May visit to Beijing.

Under Xi, China’s Communist Party has intensified efforts to bring churches and other religious communities under government supervision through its policy of “sinicization”, requiring faith groups to align with state priorities and Communist Party ideology.

Although China’s constitution formally recognizes freedom of religious belief, independent Protestant congregations face restrictions when operating outside the government-approved church system, Worthy News established. Numerous house churches reject registration, fearing political interference in their leadership, biblical teaching, and worship.

The United States Commission on International Religious Freedom said in its 2026 annual report that China continued committing particularly “severe violations” of religious freedom, including restrictions on independent church activities.

Chinese authorities have denied wrongdoing, saying churches must comply with national laws. However, Christian rights advocates argue that pastors increasingly face criminal prosecution over activities their congregations regard as legitimate expressions of faith.

Cui’s family and fellow believers suggest that his continued detention highlights the challenges facing Christians seeking to worship independently of China’s Communist Party-controlled religious institutions.

The post China Arrests Beijing House Church Pastor As Crackdown On Christians Widens appeared first on Worthy Christian News.

articles.title: Why scammers want you to allow push notifications
articles.content:
A website asks you to click “Allow” to start a quiz or read an interesting story. A little later, your device starts warning you about viruses, missed payments, or legal trouble.

While every message may look like a new security problem, the cause could be a permission you granted earlier.

For scammers, browser push notifications turn a passing visit into something much more valuable: access to your attention after you have left their website.

Two investigations—including our own research into deceptive quiz sites and HUMAN Security’s investigation of an operation called Pushpaganda—show how that permission can become a tool for repeated advertising, scareware, and fraud.

Ordinarily, a deceptive website has a limited opportunity to influence you. Once you leave, its sales pitch disappears.

A simple browser push notification permission changes that relationship. A website you’ve authorized can send browser notifications even when you’re not visiting it. Depending on the platform and browser configuration, those messages can appear even when the browser is not visibly open.

Just what scammers need

That gives scammers several advantages:

  • Repeat opportunities to get a click. Instead of relying on one visit, they can send more messages to bring you back to their sites.
  • A more convincing place to display a lie. Notifications appear through the browser and operating system, while their wording and imagery can impersonate security alerts, financial messages, or people you know.
  • Distance from the original trick. By the time alarming messages start appearing, you may not remember which website received permission, let alone connect the alerts to an innocent-looking quiz.
  • More chances to make money. The resulting traffic can feed advertising, affiliate promotions, scams, and unwanted downloads.

Allowing notifications doesn’t install malware. But scammers can use them to trick you into clicking a harmful link or downloading something dangerous. That explains why your device can display frightening warnings while a malware scan finds nothing wrong.

The campaigns

The quiz that came with an unwanted extra

Our investigation, published on March 9, began with customers who thought their devices were infected. Malwarebytes scans came up clean. Screenshots helped our Malware Removal Support team identify the real source of the trouble: web push notifications.

While the quizzes were real, the trick was making people think they had to allow the notifications to take them.

Clicking “Start the quiz” first brought up the browser’s notification permission request. Behind that legitimate browser prompt, the website displayed its own instruction:

“Click ‘Allow’ to continue.”

The page made it seem you had to allow the notifications to take the quiz, when it actually meant agreeing to receive future messages.

From clickbait to a notification loop

On April 14, HUMAN Security’s Satori researchers published a larger example of the same underlying strategy. They called it Pushpaganda.

Instead of quizzes, the operation used sensational articles and images, many showing signs of AI generation. Headlines promised attention-grabbing financial developments or implausible technology bargains. The content appeared in Google Discover feeds, exposing it to Android and Chrome users. Researchers could not establish whether those placements resulted from paid promotion or search optimization.

Once someone visited an associated website, the operation prompted them to enable notifications. The messages that followed had little to do with the article that attracted the visitor. Researchers observed fake arrest warrants, false financial alerts, and notifications mimicking missed calls from “Mom” or other family members.

Scam or legit? Scam Guard knows.

TRY IT NOW

Scam Guard stats

The graph shows weekly counts of reports classified by Scam Guard as matching quiz-site notification abuse (red) and Pushpaganda (blue), based on the information provided by users.

The counts show reports over time linked to these campaigns. They don’t represent unique victims, confirmed infections, or total campaign activity.

For context: HUMAN Security’s Satori researchers observed roughly 240 million advertising bid requests associated with Pushpaganda domains in a single seven-day period at the operation’s peak.

A bid request asks advertisers in real-time to bid for an opportunity to show an ad. In a push notification ad auction, the winning ad is sent as a notification to someone who has allowed them.

Note the dip after the reports came out. It takes time to rebuild the infrastructure, but criminals will do so if they think it’s worth the investment.

How to stay safe

Allow notifications only when you want ongoing messages from a site. A few guidelines that may help you:

  • Don’t click on prompts until you’re sure what they will set in motion.
  • Treat “Allow notifications to continue” as a red flag, particularly on quizzes, video pages, or unfamiliar websites.
  • Use web protection. Malwarebytes Browser Guard is a free tool that can help block malicious websites.

If you’re haunted by unwanted alerts, they might be web push notifications. Here’s how to identify the website sending them and turn them off in several popular browsers.

On supported Android devices, Chrome notifications include an Unsubscribe option. Use that built-in control rather than a link inside a suspicious message. When you receive an unwanted website notification through Chrome on Android:

  • Swipe down from the top of the screen to open Android’s notification shade.
  • Look for an Unsubscribe action on the notification.
  • If it is present, tap it to stop future notifications from that website. Chrome also provides Undo if you unsubscribe accidentally.

If Unsubscribe is not present, open Chrome and go to More > Settings > Site settings > Notifications. Review the allowed websites and block the offending site. You don’t need to follow a link in the suspicious notification to manage its permission.

articles.title: Two Christian Girls Die After Nigerian Captivity As Gunmen Kill Five More
articles.content:
by Stefan J. Bos, Worthy News Chief International Correspondent

ABUJA, NIGERIA (Worthy News) – Two Christian girls, aged four and 13, have died shortly after being freed from nearly seven months of captivity in Nigeria, where Muslim Fulani gunmen allegedly subjected them and other hostages to starvation, illness and abuse, Christian sources said Wednesday.

Both girls were among 11 Christians abducted on April 20 from Awon village in Kaduna state, in northwestern Nigeria. Their release came after relatives reportedly paid a ransom, but both were severely weakened by their ordeal, according to Christians familiar with the situation.

The 13-year-old girl was taken to a hospital in Kachia, where she died on November 3, a day after returning home, local resident Rueben Buhari said in remarks published by Christian Daily International–Morning Star News.

Her four-year-old fellow captive also died following her release, the Christian news agency reported. The exact date of her death was not immediately clear.

Several other hostages died before their release, including the younger girl’s pregnant mother, who gave birth while held by the gunmen. Her newborn died amid harsh conditions and a lack of medical care, and the mother also died in captivity, leaving the child without her family during the remaining months of her imprisonment.

CHILDREN SUFFER IN CAPTIVITY

Buhari said the younger girl had turned four while in captivity, and villagers feared she had died before learning that she was among those freed.

“For seven months, this little child saw things no child should ever see,” Buhari told Christian Daily International–Morning Star News, describing her ordeal.

Christian Solidarity Worldwide (CSW), a religious freedom organization, separately confirmed the 13-year-old’s death.

CSW said the militants released the hostages around November 1, with five survivors returning to their village on November 2.

Local resident Jethro Daniel said in published remarks that the captors received three motorcycles and 2 million Nigerian naira (approximately $1,480) for each person freed.

CSW separately described ransom arrangements involving three motorcycles, mobile phone recharge cards and drinks. The precise terms of the payments remained unclear.

AMNESTY DESCRIBES SEVERE ABUSE

Rights group Amnesty International’s Nigerian office previously documented deaths among the Awon hostages, including the pregnant mother and her newborn, as well as a 34-year-old man and his five-year-old son.

According to Amnesty, captives suffered severe hunger and illness, while others were beaten, humiliated and repeatedly threatened with death. It also reported sexual violence against women and girls.

CSW said the Awon captives had been held alongside worshippers abducted during attacks on Easter Sunday church services in nearby Ariko on April 5.

Seventeen of those taken from Ariko died in captivity, according to the organization, while others escaped or were eventually released.

Violence continued on November 4, when suspected Fulani militia members attacked Akwando, near Awon, killing two people and abducting 20 others, according to CSW. The hostages reportedly included women and children, with the youngest just four months old.

FIVE MORE KILLED IN PLATEAU STATE

In separate attacks on Sunday, November 8, gunmen identified by local residents as Fulani militants killed five people and wounded two others in Plateau state, in central Nigeria, Morning Star News reported.

Community leader and attorney Dalyop Solomon Mwantiri said a 65-year-old man was killed in Gwol-Hoss village in Riyom district, while four others, including a soldier and a 15-year-old boy, died in an attack on Bel village in neighboring Barkin Ladi district.

Two other residents were wounded, including a woman who was reportedly in critical condition at Jos University Teaching Hospital after undergoing surgery for multiple gunshot wounds.

These attacks raised renewed concerns about security in Plateau state, where predominantly Christian farming communities have faced repeated raids despite government security measures and restrictions on movement.

Local Christian leaders have accused armed Fulani groups of seeking to seize farmland and intimidate Christian communities. However, the wider conflict also involves competition over land and grazing rights, criminal activity and religious tensions.

KIDNAPPINGS SPREAD ACROSS NIGERIA

The girls’ deaths came amid a broader kidnapping crisis in Africa’s most populous country, where armed gangs and extremist groups have increasingly abducted villagers, schoolchildren, religious leaders and travelers for ransom.

In April, rights group Amnesty International warned that at least 1,100 people had been abducted in northern Nigeria during the first months of 2026, highlighting the scale of attacks on rural communities and displaced families.

The organization said victims were frequently subjected to starvation, torture and sexual violence, with some held for months while relatives struggled to raise money demanded by their captors.

Kidnapping has become a lucrative criminal enterprise in parts of Nigeria, where armed groups exploit weak security, remote terrain and the inability of authorities to protect vulnerable communities.

Christians have been particularly exposed in areas affected by Islamist militancy and attacks on churches, although Muslims and people from other communities have also been abducted or killed.

NIGERIA RANKS SEVENTH FOR CHRISTIAN PERSECUTION

Nigeria ranks seventh on the 2026 World Watch List published by Christian persecution watchdog Open Doors, which assesses the severity of persecution and discrimination against Christians in 50 countries.

Its ranking reflects not only killings but also abductions, attacks on churches, displacement, religious discrimination and pressure on Christians in their private, family and community lives.

Open Doors gave Nigeria a persecution score of 89 out of 100, placing it among countries experiencing extreme levels of persecution.

The organization documented 3,490 Christians killed for their faith in Nigeria during its latest reporting period, out of 4,849 worldwide, accounting for roughly 72 percent of the global total.

Although Nigeria ranks seventh overall, it recorded more reported faith-related Christian killings than any other country, according to Open Doors.

Open Doors attributes much of the violence to attacks by Islamist militant organizations, including Boko Haram and Islamic State West Africa Province, as well as radicalized Fulani armed groups targeting vulnerable communities.

RELIGIOUS AND SECURITY TENSIONS

Northern Nigeria also faces tensions over religious freedom, particularly in states where Islamic law operates alongside the country’s civil legal system. Christians who convert from Islam can face additional threats, according to Open Doors.

Across Nigeria’s Middle Belt, violence has been aggravated by disputes between farmers and herders, competition for land, expanding armed criminal networks and the activities of extremist organizations.

For Families in Awon and surrounding villages, the deaths of the two girls after their long-awaited release underscore the devastating human cost of Nigeria’s kidnapping crisis, which continues to claim lives even after captives regain their freedom.

articles.title: Six Christians Beheaded In Mozambique As Islamic State Attacks Leave At Least 19 Dead
articles.content:
by Stefan J. Bos, Worthy News Chief International Correspondent

MAPUTO, MOZAMBIQUE (Worthy News) – Six Christians have reportedly been beheaded by militants linked to the Islamic State group in northern Mozambique amid a broader wave of jihadist violence that killed at least 19 people in attacks targeting rural communities.

Christian aid organization Barnabas Aid said three believers were captured and killed on November 1 in Matambalale, a village in Muidumbe district of Cabo Delgado province, while three others were beheaded in separate attacks in neighboring Mueda district. The victims were not identified by name, age or gender.

The attacks occurred in Mozambique’s northernmost province, near the border with Tanzania, more than 1,500 kilometers (930 miles) north of the capital, Maputo. Cabo Delgado has faced a violent insurgency by jihadists, Islamist extremists seeking to impose their interpretation of Islamic law, since 2017, forcing hundreds of thousands of residents to flee their homes.

Barnabas Aid published its findings Tuesday, November 10, as conflict monitors reported that Islamic State-linked fighters had attacked at least seven communities in Mueda and Muidumbe between October 21 and 31, killing at least 19 people, all but one of them civilians.

It was unclear whether the figures overlapped.

ISLAMIC STATE CLAIMS CHRISTIAN KILLINGS

Local newspaper The Mozambique Times reported on November 2 that jihadists had beheaded at least five people in the area, citing residents who described attacks on farmers and villagers making traditional alcoholic drinks.

Islamic State also claimed responsibility for killings in the two districts, identifying the victims as Christians, according to the newspaper. However, the publication said it had independently confirmed five deaths rather than the full number claimed by the militants.

Some victims were reportedly attacked while working on farms or producing nipa, a traditional alcoholic drink that provides income for local families.

The militants oppose alcohol under their strict interpretation of Islam, raising questions about whether some villagers were targeted for their religious beliefs, their activities or both.

ACLED warned that the group’s emphasis on the Christian identity of its victims could deepen tensions between religious communities in a region where both Christians and Muslims have suffered attacks.

MOZAMBIQUE MILITARY STRUGGLES

In a November 6 assessment, ACLED said the militants had taken advantage of weaknesses in Mozambique’s military operations to carry out attacks across much of Cabo Delgado.

Fighters reportedly moved through rural communities near Mueda for more than ten days despite the presence of government troops in the region.

Most victims were ordinary civilians, including farmers and traders, rather than members of the security forces. Only one of the seven attacks documented by ACLED involved a confrontation with government troops.

The findings raised fresh concerns about the military’s ability to protect remote villages, where residents often have little warning before armed groups arrive.

Barnabas Aid said the local Islamic State affiliate may now have between 400 and 500 fighters following recruitment efforts earlier this year. The organization also reported at least eight Christian deaths in attacks during September and October.

CHRISTIANS FACE CONTINUING VIOLENCE

The insurgency has devastated communities across Cabo Delgado, with militants burning homes, attacking churches, abducting residents and driving families from their villages.

Christian persecution organization Open Doors has warned that believers face serious threats in northern Mozambique, although Muslim communities have also suffered killings, kidnappings and displacement.

Barnabas Aid estimates that about 2,750 civilians have been killed by Islamic State-linked militants since the insurgency began in 2017. Many more have been forced to abandon their homes and livelihoods.

Mozambique’s government has struggled to restore lasting security despite years of military operations and assistance from foreign forces.

For Christian families in Mueda and Muidumbe, the latest reported beheadings have renewed fears that even ordinary activities such as farming, trading or gathering food can turn deadly in areas where militants continue to operate.

articles.title: Christian Mother Pleads For Missing Daughter, 14, Amid Forced Conversion Fears In Pakistan
articles.content:
by Stefan J. Bos, Worthy News Chief International Correspondent

KARACHI, PAKISTAN (Worthy News) – A Christian mother in Pakistan has appealed for the safe return of her 14-year-old daughter, who was allegedly abducted nearly two months ago amid concerns that she may have been forced to marry and convert to Islam.

Shamim Ashraf said in remarks shared with Worthy News that her daughter disappeared from their home on September 18, 2026. Worthy News is withholding the teenager’s name because of concerns that she may have been subjected to abuse.

LEAD Ministries, a Christian human rights organization, said police subsequently launched an investigation, with further inquiries documented on September 22. The girl was reportedly taken from Karachi to Larkana, a city in Pakistan’s southern Sindh province.

The Pakistani newspaper The News International separately reported Tuesday that former provincial legislator Saleem Khursheed Khokhar had demanded the recovery of a 14-year-old Christian girl allegedly abducted in Karachi on September 18, the same date cited by LEAD Ministries.

“I request the Christian community not to politicize this matter, but to help me. Stand by me to bring back my daughter. I am a mother and I just want my daughter to return safely,” Ashraf said in remarks shared by LEAD Ministries with Worthy News.

CHRISTIAN GIRL’S SAFETY

LEAD Ministries said the family’s lawyer had reportedly filed a constitutional petition before a High Court, although the status of the legal proceedings could not be independently confirmed.

The girl’s whereabouts and the circumstances surrounding her disappearance remained unclear Tuesday.

Sardar Mushtaq Gill, a lawyer and founder and international advocacy director of LEAD Ministries, urged Pakistani authorities to establish the teenager’s whereabouts, verify her age through official records and ensure she can speak freely before a judicial authority without intimidation.

LEAD Ministries said the girl had reportedly not yet been able to give a formal statement before a judge, where she could explain what happened without pressure or intimidation.

Gill urged authorities to investigate the alleged abduction and determine whether she had been pressured into converting to Islam or marrying against her will.

FORCED CONVERSION CONCERNS

“Our daughters are not objects to be taken, manipulated, or forced into decisions about their lives. Every girl deserves protection, dignity, education, freedom, and a childhood free from fear,” Gill said in a statement shared with Worthy News.

The family is also facing financial difficulties after Ashraf’s husband reportedly suffered a leg fracture in an accident, leaving him unable to work while the search for their daughter continues.

The case comes amid longstanding concerns about the treatment of Christian and Hindu girls in Pakistan, a Muslim-majority nation where human rights organizations have documented abductions, forced religious conversions and underage marriages.

In April 2026, United Nations human rights experts warned about forced religious conversions and marriages involving minority women and girls, urging Pakistani authorities to strengthen protections and investigate complaints.

Christian Solidarity Worldwide (CSW), a religious rights group, cited research by the Centre for Social Justice documenting 94 cases involving the abduction, forced conversion or forced marriage of religious minority women and girls in 2025, compared with 83 in 2024. Of the 2025 victims, 71 were Hindu and 23 Christian.

PAKISTAN MINORITY RIGHTS

The United Nations experts said about 75 percent of women and girls affected by forced conversion through marriage in 2025 were Hindu and 25 percent Christian, with nearly 80 percent of reported incidents occurring in Sindh province.

The experts warned that minority girls continued to face serious risks because their legal rights were not always upheld, particularly when authorities failed to investigate complaints or verify their ages.

They urged Pakistan to investigate such allegations impartially, verify the ages of affected girls and ensure that religious conversions and marriages are based on genuine, freely given consent.

They also raised concerns that police sometimes dismiss complaints from minority families or fail to investigate allegations promptly.

Gill called on churches, international human rights organizations and diplomatic missions to support efforts to protect the missing teenager and other vulnerable minority girls. He stressed that responsibility for preventing exploitation rests with authorities and society, not with the girls themselves.

For Ashraf’s family, the immediate concern remains the safe return of the teenager.

The post Christian Mother Pleads For Missing Daughter, 14, Amid Forced Conversion Fears In Pakistan appeared first on Worthy Christian News.

What the paper found

37% higher non-COVID mortality in people who got Pfizer.

That’s a train wreck.

Possible explanations for the results:

  1. The Pfizer/Moderna groups weren’t really matched

  2. Moderna reduces non-COVID all-cause mortality by 37%

The problems:

  1. They were matched. Barbra Dickerman wrote 2 papers on COVID vaccines and VA data showing that crude demographic matching creates extremely good morbidity matching to nobody’s surprise. But Levi’s matching was MUCH stronger than what Dickerman did (more attributes and tighter matches). And he confirmed the matching by looking at the single most devastating statistic: prior cardiovascular hospitalization rates were matched. This is not a random marker — it's arguably the single most mortality-relevant clinical signal you can extract from administrative data. So we have no reason to believe the groups weren’t matched and every reason to believe they were.

  2. There is no mechanism of action that could possibly explain how a COVID vaccine can reduce non-COVID all-cause mortality by 37%. If that were true, this would be the most amazing drug ever created. Moderna would be marketing their COVID vaccine as a fountain of youth. Everyone would be taking it. We’d have seen dramatic reduction in all cause mortality all over the world after rolling out the drug. No such data exists. You don’t need an unvaccinated comparison group. In fact due to the healthy vaccine effect, such a comparison would be extremely problematic. Dr. Wong failed to point that out.

Wong’s argument is like observing that two groups are identical on 100 different metrics except death, and they differ in only one factor: brand of vaccine, and saying that “well, you didn’t match on EVERY possible metric!”

Professor Morris claims other AI’s support his analysis.

The problem is that they can’t possibly cause a mortality difference of the size observed.

The COVID vaccines were deadly.

articles.title: Searching for John Foxe and His Book of Martyrs
articles.content:
Foxe’s Book of Martyrs was first published in English nearly five hundred years ago (1563). Today, there are many editions of this book available because it is in the public domain. When Lighthouse Trails decided to start offering this book to our readers several years ago, we began our search for a suitable edition. Much to our dismay, we discovered that many of the current editions were compromised in one form or another. For example, in one edition by a Christian publisher, front-page endorsements included the names of practitioners of contemplative prayer (a spirituality that thrives from the impetus of the Roman Catholic Church and embraces some of the same beliefs that Foxe’s martyrs opposed to the point of suffering cruel persecution and death). It is most troubling to see such names in the cover of an edition of Foxe’s Book of Martyrs.

In another edition we reviewed in our search, the book was among a special set of “Christian classics.” We were once again perplexed to see that some of the other books in that series were written by contemplative mystics.

And yet another edition, published by a secular publisher, advertised mystical and occult practices on the back cover. Such things can happen when a book goes into the public domain.

Worth noting, in John Foxe’s original Book of Martyrs, Foxe wrote much about persecutions coming from the Catholic Church. But in some of today’s editions, you will find stories of this papal persecution omitted. One very popular large Christian organization did such a thing as this quote from The Berean Call documents:

Foxe’s Book of Martyrs is best known for its recounting of history and compilation of brief biographies of Christians killed by the Roman Catholic Church. In 2007, the organization Voice of the Martyrs published a volume titled FOXE: Voices of the Martyrs, with the authors listed as “John Foxe and The Voice of the Martyrs.”

Despite its name, the book FOXE: Voices of the Martyrs bears no resemblance to Foxe’s Book of Martyrs. The modern book omits Foxe’s history, with no mention of the Inquisition, of which Foxe said, “In the space of one hundred and twenty nine years, the inquisition deprived Spain of three millions of inhabitants”1 (a subject to which Foxe devoted an entire chapter). It also makes no mention of God sparing England from both the assault of the Spanish Armada and from the “conspiracy by the Papists” to blow up both houses of Parliament and the royal family, a conspiracy known as The Gunpowder Plot of 1605 (these were the subject of another chapter by Foxe).2

When FOXE: Voices of the Martyrs makes mention of persons from Foxe’s Book of Martyrs, the writer removes most of Foxe’s points. The book even includes at least a dozen Roman Catholics cited as martyrs.3 [VOM’s] FOXE: Voices of the Martyrs goes so far as to include a section on the Jesuits that begins with the paean, “Founded by Ignatius of Loyola in 1540, the Jesuits have been the most successful missionary movement in the Catholic Church.”4 [For those not familiar with the Jesuits, they were a Catholic order set up to bring people into the Catholic Church either by coercion or force and to bring an end to the Protestant reformation.]5

Finally, after an unsuccessful search, for an edition of Foxe’s Book of Martyrs that we could offer to our readers, Lighthouse Trails decided to publish its own edition of this truly incredible and unforgettable account. articles.title: Paus dan Kepala Gereja Inggris
articles.content:
Sumber: www.wayoflife.org

“Gereja” esa-sedunia sedang menunjukkan kemajuan pesat dalam persiapannya menuju wujud penuh “Misteri Babel” sebagaimana tertulis dalam Wahyu 17. Pada tahun 1521, Martin Luther dikucilkan oleh Paus Leo X, dan Reformasi Protestan pun dimulai, dengan gereja-gereja Lutheran menyebar ke seluruh wilayah Jerman dan Skandinavia. Pada tahun 1525, Ulrich Zwingli memisahkan diri dari Roma di Zurich, Swiss, dan memimpin gerakan Protestan di wilayah tersebut. Pada tahun 1530, John Calvin memisahkan diri dari Roma, dan enam tahun kemudian menerbitkan Institutio Christianae Religionis (Pengajaran Agama Kristen), yang menjadi landasan doktrinal bagi gereja-gereja Protestan Presbiterian dan Reformed. Pada tahun 1534, Raja Henry VIII memisahkan diri dari Roma dan mendirikan Gereja Inggris (Church of England) dengan dirinya sendiri sebagai kepalanya. Antara tahun 1545–1563, Konsili Trente dari Gereja Katolik Roma melontarkan 125 anathema (kutukan hukuman kekal) terhadap semua orang Kristen non-Katolik, termasuk mereka yang meyakini bahwa keselamatan diperoleh semata-mata oleh kasih karunia Allah tanpa perbuatan baik.

Kini, sejak abad ke-20, kita menyaksikan pembalikan arah dari Reformasi serta penyatuan ekumenis antara pihak Protestan dan Roma. Peristiwa berikut ini merupakan langkah terbaru dalam rekonsiliasi Gereja Inggris dengan Roma. Dikutip dari “Raja Inggris menganugerahkan sebuah kehormatan,” Zenit News, 23 Oktober 2026: “Paus Leo XIV telah menerima gelar kehormatan di Kapel St. George, Kastel Windsor. Penerimaan ini melengkapi pertukaran simbolis persaudaraan dengan Raja Charles III, yang menandai perbaikan hubungan secara bertahap antara Gereja Katolik dan tradisi Anglikan. Pengumuman tersebut disampaikan pada 23 Oktober 2026 oleh Dekan dan para Kanon Windsor, dengan persetujuan dari monarki Inggris serta dukungan dari Uskup Agung Canterbury. Paus telah diangkat sebagai Papal Confrater (anggota persaudaraan kehormatan) di College of St. George — sebuah gestur yang digambarkan oleh pihak Istana Kerajaan sebagai wujud nyata dari persekutuan rohani, persahabatan ekumenis, dan persaudaraan Kristiani. Pengangkatan ini terjadi tepat satu tahun setelah kunjungan kenegaraan bersejarah Raja Charles III dan Ratu Camilla ke Vatikan pada 23 Oktober 2025, di mana pasangan kerajaan tersebut bertemu dengan Leo XIV dan mengunjungi sejumlah situs keagamaan penting, termasuk Kapel Sistina dan Kapel Paulina. Dalam kunjungan tersebut, Raja diterima sebagai Royal Confrater di Basilika Kepausan St. Paulus di Luar Tembok, dengan persetujuan Paus. Gelar kehormatan baru ini merupakan bentuk timbal balik atas gestur tersebut, yang mengubah rasa saling hormat menjadi simbol publik akan komitmen bersama kedua institusi tersebut terhadap kesatuan umat Kristiani.”

I’ve worked with DMSO for a while now, and I keep finding new ways it can help in healing the body –not in every case, but in many. Here are some of the heavy hitters:

1. Cryoprotective Power: Ever wonder how we keep hearts, other organs like livers, corneas, and even stem cells from getting freezer-burned during storage? DMSO lowers water’s freezing point and keeps ice crystals from shredding delicate tissue. In the handful of organ transplant cases I assisted in, the organ transport team used a DMSO bath for the organs or tissue we harvested.

2. Potent Anti-Inflammatory: Works like aspirin or ibuprofen without trashing your gut. It tames swelling and pain naturally.

3. Vasodilation Boost: Opens up blood vessels so nutrients can get in and waste can get out faster.

4. Cell Permeability Wizard: Helps your cells take in the good stuff and flush the bad stuff.

5. Transdermal Superhighway: This is one of my favorite features: rub it on your skin and it’s well inside all of you within 5-10 minutes. It’ll carry dozens of things like CBD, essential oils, MSM, arnica oil or magnesium deep into your tissues where they can really work.

6. Pain Shield: Calms down nerve signals and protects tissue from mechanical or chemical injury.

7. Scar Tissue Softener: Helps dissolve and loosen up scar tissue and stiffness after surgeries or injuries. We can use in conjunction with homeopathic thiosinaminum.

The Transdermal Superhighway Effect of DMSO

DMSO’s ability to integrate seamlessly with other natural treatments amplifies its appeal to those pursuing holistic health. By combining DMSO with castor oil, aloe vera, vitamin C, colloidal silver, cayenne, magnesium, CBD oil, or many other botanical medicines, users can experience enhanced effects that address not just symptoms but also the underlying causes of health issues. For anyone looking to take control of their health, this synergistic combination approach offers a path forward.

[A number of the recipes to follow are from Dr. Amelia White’s independently published book, The Complete DMSO Healing Bible.]

These recipe combinations reflect DMSO’s versatility and adaptability in addressing a broad-spectrum of health concerns naturally. DMSO represents a shift away from reliance on pharmaceutical interventions and toward preventative health and medical independence. Its use encourages individuals to take an active role in their well-being by exploring safe, natural solutions that align with the body’s innate biology.

Healing with Natural DMSO Combinations

While many natural substances could be mixed with DMSO, AMD mentions about 120 that have been primarily focused on, many of which were chosen due to their existing popularity within the natural medicine field, and a smaller number of which were adopted due to their unique synergies with DMSO. They are as follows:

Carrier Oils and Topical Bases — Aloe Vera, Castor Oil, Coconut Oil, Shea Butter, organic GF Beef Tallow, MCT Oil, EV Olive Oil, Jojoba Oil, Sesame Oil (links provided so you can read more)

When DMSO is used 7 days a week, it can sometimes dry the skin (due to the skin’s oils being drawn inward). For that reason, many individuals find they have a better response to DMSO within a carrier oil.

Many of these carrier oils also have a variety of other therapeutic properties, which make them popular to use with DMSO (e.g., for skin, prostate, musculoskeletal, or eye issues, along with wound healing, burns, cataracts, Complex regional pain syndrome (CRPS), Alzheimer’s, and hernias). Likewise in some cases, DMSO improves the functionality and utility of a carrier oil.

Essential Oils  (many of these are “kid safe’) — Frankincense, Tea Tree, Peppermint, Defender, Lavender, Eucalyptus, Myrrh, Black Pepper, Helichrysum, Wintergreen, Clary Sage, Thyme, Oregano, Rosemary.

Generally, these combinations aim to extenuate the known properties of the oils. Some treat a variety of infections, many are used for musculoskeletal issues and reducing inflammation, others treat a variety of types of pain such as headaches and sciatica, while others improve circulation, parasympathetic tone, anxiety, digestion, and autoimmune conditions like asthma and psoriasis. Additionally, DMSO lowers the amount of the essential oil needed and makes it much easier to treat conditions that affect the skin and underlying tissues (e.g., infections).

Healing Botanicals 

Arnica, Comfrey, Turmeric, Black Cumin Seed Oil, Cayenne Pepper, Sea Vegetables, White Willow Bark, Lemon Balm, Eyebright, Hawthorn or Heart Health, your CBD Oil, Amygdalin (as apricot seeds), Nettles, Saw Palmetto, Sulforaphane (from broccoli sprouts), Black Salve Extract, Horse Chestnut (for varicose veins), Ginger, Green Tea Extract, Dandelion, Neem Oil, Passion Flower for restful sleep, and Ginkgo for concentration and memory. Note: many other herbal preparations are also used with DMSO.

A few of these have remarkable anti-inflammatory properties, are excellent for healing injuries or pain, and frequently are far more effective than standard preparations of the herb. Many also treat a wide variety of skin conditions (including growths like lipomas and seborrheic keratosis), others address visual and cardiovascular, issues (e.g., cataracts), one has been used to treat Parkinson’s, another for hyperthyroidism, another for seizures, a few are used for anxiety and insomnia and many have been used to improve cognition.

Healing Vitamins and Antioxidants

Vitamin C, B12, D, natural Vit. E, K, Glutathione, NAC, MSM, B-complexes, Multivitamins, Alpha-Lipoic-Acid, CoQ10, Superoxide Dismutase

Nutraceuticals are often mixed with DMSO to have greater absorption of them (and increased potency) without requiring them to be injected (e.g., many have remarkable improvements in energy levels from topical DMSO vitamin combinations). In many cases, this has allowed the vitamin to function in a regenerative/healing manner in ways that differ significantly from the standard preparation (e.g., these combinations are frequently used to cure osteoarthritis, hearing loss, loss of smell, and tinnitus) or surmounted a fundamental clinical limitation of the nutraceutical.

Finally, many of these nutraceuticals are used for specific diseases (e.g., prostate enlargement, Parkinson’s, cataracts, glaucoma, COPD, asthma, cystic fibrosis, and a wide variety of stubborn infections throughout the body).

Minerals — Magnesium, Clinoptilolite Zeolite for gentle detox, Iodine, Colloidal Silver, Selenium, Boron, Zinc, Silica for hair loss, etc.

The most common uses for the minerals are musculoskeletal (e.g., healing from injuries, reducing pain, improving wound healing, and muscle relaxation), eliminating infections throughout the body, and treating a variety of glandular issues (e.g., in the thyroid, prostate, and breast). They are also sometimes used for a variety of other diseases (nail fungal overgrowths, protecting the nervous system, improving fatigue, and addressing a variety of joint issues (e.g., arthritis and gout).

Natural Metabolites — Lactic Acid, Hyaluronic Acid, Manuka Honey, Apple Cider Vinegar, Propolis & Royal Jelly, Fulvic Acid and Humic Acids

Many of these have a remarkable restorative or healing capacity on the body (e.g., many have had success using one to treat Chronic Fatigue Syndrome while others have been repeatedly used to rebuild connective tissue, strengthen blood vessels and revitalize the skin).

DMSO Product Resources: 

Formulations by The DMSO Store [possibly purest, high GMP standards]. AMD’s Recommended DMSO Sources:

• DMSO Liquid Pharmaceutical Grade 4 oz. 99.995% Purity, Low Odor, Non-Diluted, Glass Bottle with Dropper

• DMSO Gel 4.oz Non-diluted 99.995% Low Odor Pharma Grade

• DMSO 70/30 16 oz. Gel with Distilled Water 

• DMSO pump spray bottle which can be diluted with distilled water

• DMSO Non-diluted Roll-On, 3 oz. (non-refillable)

• DMSO 70%/30% Aloe Gel Roll-On, 3 oz. (non-refillable)

I’ve made a board of DMSO products all in one place. Read about them over in my Amazon Store. [Note: Nicotine is a whole other topic. There are 4 posts on non-addictive nicotine due to the depth  and breadth of what it can be used for.]

Gels vs. Liquids:

Gel can be easier to apply and a bit less messy, still liquid is what AMD uses. Many suggest starting with DMSO Store non-diluted liquid roll-on on clean, dry skin to get a feel for the product.

To keep this post shorter, please go here and scroll down to learn how to patch test skin, and for specifics on HOW to dilute and use DMSO both topically and orally. A Midwestern Doctor (the expert) has kept this information behind a paywall.

Important Notes on Diluting, Measuring, and Safe for DMSO Materials

• Use Reverse Osmosis water or distilled water to dilute DMSO to required %.  Calculator

• To make these recipes, you will need a 50ml amber glass dropper bottle and small marked measuring glass for measuring in millileters (mL) as in the recipes below. Since you’re working with DMSO, to make combination recipes in a compatible roller ball, this PP (polypropylene) roller ball applicator is the right call, and it is not so small that you need to refill it often.

• When mixing and storing, remember glass is non-reactive and does not give off toxins like plastics can. Not all plastics are incompatible with DMSO. DMSO is compatible with plastics such as PETE, HDPE, LDPE, and polypropylene #5 (PP) without the risk of contamination or reactivity. Avoid application with synthetic fragrances, as DMSO also increases absorption of unwanted substances into the body.
• Why This Matters: DMSO penetrates skin rapidly and carries whatever dissolves into it directly into your body. If your storage container leaches chemicals into the DMSO, those contaminants come with it. Even the label adhesive on your bottle (or Sharpie ink) can leach into you, so I hold and apply the roller bottle with 1 dry hand and massage in with the other. 

• After massaging in with fingertips, wash hands well with just plain water or only VERY basic soap (like Bronner’s Castile) before moving onto other things which could possibly draw in contaminants. PS. this soap has become my facial soap because of it’s pure ingredients.

Before you look over the recipes, this will give you an idea of how cool and transformative using DMSO with a botanical, vitamin, or antioxidant like MSM can be:

12 minutes.

﻿

23 Fabulous Synergistic Recipes:

1. Burn Soothing Gel

This gel reduces pain, prevents infection, and promotes skin repair in minor burns. Lavender oil soothes irritation, while aloe vera hydrates the skin. Don’t use on open wounds or third-degree burns. Ingredients: 1 small glass jar with lid, 2-3 tablespoons 50% DMSO solution, 2 tablespoons aloe vera gel with no preservatives, 1 teaspoon silver gel, 5 drops lavender essential oil. Instructions: Mix DMSO solution with aloe and lavender oil. Gently mix before each use and gently apply to minor burns. Avoiding rubbing and leave on until absorbed. Apply 2-3 times daily as needed.

2. Respiratory Support Chest Rub

This chest rub aids in relieving congestion and supporting respiratory health. Use as needed during colds or respiratory discomfort. Avoid the eyes. Ingredients: 50 mL glass jar, 30 mL 99.99% pharmaceutical-grade DMSO, 10 mL non-refined virgin coconut oil, 10 mL eucalyptus essential oil, 2 drops peppermint essential oil. Instructions: Melt coconut oil over very low heat and mix in DMSO and essential oils. Transfer to a small glass jar and it will thicken as it cools. Apply a small amount to the chest, massaging gently. 

3. Varicose Veins

This topical solution improves blood flow and shrinks/reduces the appearance of varicose veins. Apply daily, focusing on affected areas.  Ingredients: this refillable DMSO-approved (polypropylene) roller bottle, 30 mL 99.995% pharmaceutical-grade DMSO, 10 mL distilled water to dilute, 5 mL witch hazel, 5 drops lavender and 5 drops helichrysum essential oils. Instructions: Combine all ingredients  and replace the refillable roller top, shaking gently to blend before use. Roll onto worst areas and gently massage into the skin. Use twice daily for optimal results. Let dry 10-20 minutes.

4. Topical Scar Healing Cream

This cream promotes scar healing by softening tissue, reducing discoloration, and stimulating collagen production. Vitamin E and calendula oil enhance skin repair and hydration. Use for at least four weeks for noticeable improvements. Ingredients: 4 teaspoons of DMSO diluted to 70% solution, 1 teaspoon of this natural (not synthetic) vitamin E oil, and 1 teaspoon organic calendula oil. May add 3 pillules of thiosinaminum 6 and let dissolve (read about this amazing homeopathic here). Instructions: Blend ingredients thoroughly in a small glass container. Apply the cream to scars twice daily, massaging it gently into the skin.

5. Joint Pain Relief Gel 

This gel helps reduce inflammation, ease joint stiffness, and promote circulation in affected areas.  Ingredients: 2 tablespoons 70% DMSO gel, 2 tablespoons Aloe vera gel (preservative-free), 15 drops wintergreen essential oil, and 1 teaspoon arnica oil.  Instructions: Mix everything thoroughly in a small glass bowl. Massage the gel to the affected joint twice daily. Store any remaining mixture in a glass airtight container away from light. Use consistently for several weeks for best results.

6. Acne Treatment Solution

This solution targets acne by reducing inflammation, fighting bacteria, and promoting skin healing. Tea tree oil acts as a natural antimicrobial agent, while aloe vera soothes irritated skin. Do a patch skin test first. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Ingredients: 4-5 teaspoons of 40% DMSO solution, 5 drops tea tree essential oil, 2 teaspoons aloe vera juice. Instructions: Mix together in a small dish. Dab the mixture onto acne-prone areas using a cotton swab using clean hands. Avoid the temptation to squeeze your face. Allow it to completely dry before applying any other products. Apply twice daily for best results.

7. Restless Leg Soothing Roll-On

This spray is designed to improve circulation and ease the discomfort of restless leg syndrome, particularly during the evening when symptoms often worsen, providing a calming effect. Ingredients: this refillable 50 mL DMSO-approved (polypropylene) roller bottle, ~42 mL 70% DMSO solution, 3 tablespoons magnesium oil, 5 drops lavender essential oil. Instructions: Add the ingredients into a roller ball bottle. Shake first and apply evenly over clean legs and feet, ensuring full coverage. Gently massage the solution into the skin until fully absorbed. Allow it to dry before lying down or covering with bedding. Use nightly before bed.

8. Cold Sore Relief 

This treatment alleviates pain, reduces swelling, and accelerates the healing of cold sores. Lemon balm oil has antiviral properties, while colloidal silver aids in infection control. Avoid use on areas other than cold sores, and always use clean tools to apply. Ingredients: 2 teaspoons 50% DMSO solution, 5 drops lemon balm [melissa officianalis] essential oil. Since the EO is very expensive, you can substitute 30 drops lemon balm [melissa officianalis] tincture , and 1 teaspoon colloidal silver. Instructions: Mix all together in a small container. Apply directly to cold sores using a cotton swab. Repeat 3-4 times daily.

9. Sinus Rinse

This healing sinus rinse helps manage infections, polyps, and general inflammation with a gentle 5–10% DMSO concentration. Avoid usage if the nasal lining is raw or bleeding. Frequent use may alleviate chronic issues, but always consult a specialist for severe conditions. Ingredients: 12 mL 99.995 percent pharmaceutical-grade DMSO, a ceramic Neti pot, 8 ounces distilled water, ¼ teaspoon neti salt or noniodized sea salt, ½ teaspoon 20 ppm colloidal silver, ½ teaspoon preservative-free aloe vera juice (optional). Instructions: Dissolve salt in lukewarm distilled water. Mix in DMSO and colloidal silver, stirring gently. Add aloe vera gel juice if the solution stings. Use with a neti pot or nasal applicator to flush both sinuses, ensuring hygiene throughout the process.

10. Soothing Foot Bath in a stainless or #5 plastic (polypropylene) foot tub

This bath promotes detoxification and reduces inflammation by drawing out toxins through the feet. Baking soda neutralizes acidity, while Epsom salts relax muscles. Use 1-2 times weekly for overall wellness.  Ingredients: ½ cup DMSO (30% solution), 1 cup Epsom salts, 1 tablespoon baking soda, 3 drops tea tree essential oil. Use warm water. Instructions: Dissolve Epsom salts and baking soda in warm water in a stainless steel or porcelain (not run of the mill plastic or aluminum) foot basin. Add the DMSO solution. Soak feet for 20-30 minutes and pat dry.

11. Wrinkle Reduction Serum

This serum reduces fine lines and wrinkles by boosting skin hydration and collagen production. DMSO enhances the penetration of vitamin E, castor oil, and rosehip oil to deeper cell layers almost like Botox. Apply nightly to clean skin. Test a small area first for sensitivity. Ingredients: 1 teaspoon 40% DMSO solution, 1 teaspoon vitamin E oil, 1 teaspoon rosehip oil. Instructions: Mix all ingredients in a small container. Apply a few drops to the face, focusing on problem areas. Gently massage until absorbed.

12. Digestive Support Drink

This drink supports digestion and helps with inflammation in the gut lining. DMSO enhances the delivery of aloe vera, soothing irritation. Consume once daily on an empty stomach. Ingredients: 1 teaspoon 30% DMSO solution 2 ounces aloe vera juice. Instructions: Combine all ingredients in a glass and mix well. Drink immediately.

13. Shingles Soothing Gel

This gel is formulated to alleviate the pain, inflammation, and discomfort associated with shingles. The combination of DMSO, colloidal silver, and aloe vera promotes healing and soothes irritated skin. Apply twice daily to the affected areas. Avoid applying to broken skin and consult a healthcare professional if symptoms worsen. Ingredients: 2 tablespoons 50% DMSO solution, 2 tablespoons aloe vera gel (preservative-free) 1 teaspoon colloidal silver (10–15 ppm) Instructions: Mix the DMSO solution, silver, and aloe vera gel in a small glass bowl or ramekin until evenly mixed. Transfer the gel into a clean, airtight glass container. Apply a thin layer over the shingles-affected area, avoiding any open sores. Let the gel absorb completely and air dry.

14. Osteoarthritis Relief Cream

This cream is formulated to ease the pain and inflammation caused by osteoarthritis, promoting joint flexibility and reducing discomfort. The healing combination of DMSO, magnesium oil, and aloe vera provides soothing relief while encouraging tissue repair. Use twice daily on the affected joints for best results. Ingredients: 2 tablespoons 70% DMSO solution, 2 tablespoons preservative-free aloe vera gel, 1 tablespoon magnesium oil, and 5-6 drops of each ginger, eucalyptus, and lavender essential oils, all known to help osteoarthritis. Instructions: In a small glass ramekin or bowl, mix everything until a smooth consistency is achieved. Apply a thin layer of the cream to the affected joints, gently massaging it into the skin. Leave it to absorb for 20 minutes before wiping off any residue with a warm, damp cloth. Repeat the process in the morning and evening for sustained relief.

15. Anti-Aging Eye Serum

This serum reduces puffiness and dark circles while hydrating the delicate skin above, below and around the eyes. Use nightly before bed. Avoid getting the serum directly into the eyes. Ingredients: 1 teaspoon 30% DMSO solution, 1 teaspoon aloe vera gel, 1/2 teaspoon castor oil, and 2 drops chamomile essential oil. Instructions: Blend all ingredients in a small glass container. Apply a small amount around the eyes using the fingertips, gently patting it into the skin. This does wonders for may over time, including me.

16. Antifungal Drops

This formula is highly effective against toenail fungus, athlete’s foot, jock itch, and candida-related fungal issues. It’s also beneficial for fungal infections in animals, particularly dogs prone to ear infections or wet skin irritation. Regular application can show results over several weeks, but complete healing for stubborn infections may take up to six months. Ensure proper hygiene and avoid cross-contamination by replacing old footwear or thoroughly cleaning it. Ingredients: 50 mL glass dropper bottle, 44 mL 99.995% pharmaceutical-grade DMSO, 1 mL Lugol’s 2% iodine or 10% povidone-iodine, 10 drops tea tree essential oil. Apply right out of the shower (and several more times a day if possible) with the dropper to the affected toe nail that has been kept trimmed and filed thin so it doesn’t have so far to go to get to the fungus entombed under the nail bed. It will take persistence and a lot depends on the person’s general health.

17. Ear Drops

This 10% DMSO and colloidal silver solution addresses ear infections, inflammation, and discomfort. Use for one week, continuing treatment for a few days after symptoms subside to prevent recurrence. Do not use if the eardrum is ruptured or if fluid leakage persists without medical advice. Ingredients: 50 mL glass dropper bottle, 45 mL colloidal silver, 5 mL 99.995 percent pharmaceutical-grade DMSO, and 10 drops mullein garlic oil. Instructions: Combine in the new dropper bottle. Shake gently and allow the exothermic (heat) reaction to complete then add the mullein oil. Apply 1–2 drops in each ear once or twice daily for a week. Label and date the bottle, and replace the solution after six months.

18. Mouthwash

This mouthwash addresses gum disease and minor oral infections. Ingredients: 5 mL 99.995% pharmaceutical-grade DMSO, 5 mL 3% food-grade hydrogen peroxide, 10-12 mL distilled water or preservative-free aloe vera gel or juice. Instructions: Mix all ingredients in a clean container. Swish twice daily, but don’t swallow it. Rinse thoroughly with water after use.

19. Topical Vitamin and Mineral Blend

If you have a patient that cannot swallow, this topical blend provides essential vitamins and minerals transdermally to support overall health. Apply daily or as needed, but monitor skin reactions to ensure compatibility. Not for internal use. Ingredients: 50 mL glass dropper bottle, 40 mL 99.995% pharmaceutical-grade DMSO, 10mL ionic trace mineral drops, 1 mL magnesium oil, 2 drops Lugol’s 2% iodine or povidone-iodine, powder from 1/2 whole food capsule methylated B-complex vitamin, 10 mL preservative-free aloe vera gel or juice, and powder from ½ capsule whole food vitamin C. Instructions: Using a funnel, add all ingredients to the bottle. Shake well to combine. With whole food caps, it may have slight greenish tint. Apply 3–5 mL to targeted areas of the body once or twice daily. Store in a cool, dark place and replace the mixture after six months.

20. Arthritis Joint Relief Rub

This rub alleviates joint and inflammation caused by arthritis. Its combination of DMSO, turmeric, and ginger penetrates deeply to reduce discomfort. Ingredients: 50 mL glass jar, 30 mL 99.995% pharmaceutical-grade DMSO, 10 mL distilled water to dilute, 2 teaspoons turmeric tincture, 1 teaspoon ginger powder or tincture, 1/2 teaspoon arnica oil, 1 teaspoon virgin (not refined) coconut oil. Instructions: Mix all into a paste. Slowly add DMSO and distilled water, stirring continuously to blend. Apply a small amount over the affected joint, massaging gently. Leave for 15–20 minutes, then wipe away residue with a damp cloth. Use twice daily for best results.

21. Stretch Mark Reduction Blend

This formula targets stretch marks, improving skin elasticity and appearance. Apply daily for several weeks to see visible results. Do not use on irritated or broken skin. Ingredients: 50 mL glass bottle with dropper 20 mL 99.995% pharmaceutical-grade DMSO, 10 mL vitamin E oil, 10 mL rosehip oil, 10 mL aloe vera gel/ juice. Instructions: Combine all ingredients in the bottle and shake to mix thoroughly. Apply a few drops to stretch marks, massaging gently into the skin. Allow the blend to absorb fully.

22. Healing Salve for Cracked Heels

This rich salve heals cracked heels, moisturizing and softening the skin. Apply nightly for best results. Avoid using on infected skin. Ingredients: 50 mL glass jar, 20 mL 99.995% pharmaceutical-grade DMSO, 15 mL coconut oil, 10 mL shea butter, 5 mL vitamin E oil. Instructions: Melt coconut oil and shea butter together over low heat. Stir in vitamin E oil and DMSO. Allow to cool before transferring to the jar. Massage into clean heels and wear old, clean cotton socks overnight.

23. Muscle Recovery Roll- On

This roll-on supports muscle recovery after work outs or overuse by increasing circulation, relaxing tense muscles, and replenishing magnesium levels, which are often depleted during intense activity. Peppermint oil provides a cooling sensation to relieve soreness. Ingredients: this refillable 50 mL DMSO-approved (polypropylene) roller bottle, 50% DMSO solution, 3 tablespoons magnesium oil, 5 drops peppermint essential oil, 5 drops lavender essential oil. Instructions: Add the ingredients into a roller ball bottle. Shake well before use. Wipe off sweat (as it contains toxins the body just released) before applying. Roll on and gently massage until absorbed.

Conclusion:

For the preparedness-minded, these small yet impactful uses embody the spirit of natural self-care. You can print out these recipes and keep them handy for minimal effort and maximum efficacy.

Despite its numerous benefits, DMSO remains underutilized and often misunderstood. Regulatory agencies, influenced by pharmaceutical interests, have limited public access to DMSO and its full healing potential until recently.

While DMSO combination therapies are generally safe, there are several risks and safety considerations, particularly once one begins experimenting with them. A Midwestern Doctor’s previous article lists a variety of critical rules to understand when creating your own healing combination therapies. In every case, do not use on open sores, fresh wounds, or sensitive skin without first patch testing.

From its ability to carry both beneficial and harmful compounds through the skin barrier, DMSO teaches an important lesson: the choices we make about what we consume, apply, and expose ourselves to have a profound impact on our health.

DMSO is not just a molecule; it is a testament to the power of God’s natural healing gifts. Our Creator put it in the trees just for us. Its ability to alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, enhance absorption, and promote holistic health has transformed countless lives.

2026: Now the first mRNA flu shot – with claims of plague thrown in to drive the narrative? 

Yersinia pestis is a genuine pathogen that has killed enormous numbers of people across history, and bacterial lung infections are real. But the gap between a real bacterium and a global panic is exactly where the psyop lives. My answer is not submission to agencies, not a rushed vaccine, and not a lifetime of fear. My answer is preparation, nutrition, herbal medicine, clean air, and a mind that refuses to be hijacked by a single alarming headline.

Anything Natural That Can Kill the (Bubonic) Plague Pathogen?

The pneumonic plague story is a psychological operation aimed at the weak-minded, and the next step will almost certainly be a vaccine push I would not trust under any circumstances. The pattern is too familiar to ignore: a distant, unconfirmed event becomes a global emergency, an unverified claim becomes settled fact, and a product that did not exist last year becomes the only acceptable solution. The disease changes. The script does not.

First, an honest distinction that the fear merchants never make:

There is a difference between daily prevention and emergency intervention. If you have a raging lung infection, if you are coughing up fluid, if you cannot breathe — go to an emergency room. Antibiotics like doxycycline can be legitimate short-term tools in an acute crisis, but I would reject fluoroquinolones if offered. Levaquin and Cipro and their siblings act like chemo drugs and can seriously harm your DNA and they can kill you outright.

No one is telling you to reject a life-saving drug in an acute emergency. I am telling you to build a body that never faces the emergency in the first place.

Nutrients that fortify you against bacterial lung infections for daily defense

–Vitamin C (as buffered sodium ascorbate or as whole food capsules – at 1,000 milligrams, 2-3l times daily, supports epithelial barrier integrity and immune cell function.

–Vitamin A from this cod liver oil (without synthetic retinyl palmitate) supports mucosal immunity.

—Vitamin D, zinc, and selenium are critical for immune competence.

(Or see my Amazon Store here for Immune Health supplements.)

–Keep iron balanced, because excess iron feeds bacteria — Yersinia pestis actually uses a siderophore for iron uptake as a virulence factor. (source)

–Adequate protein matters enormously, and so does sleep.

None of this is exotic. All of it is dismissed by a medical establishment that prefers to sell you a shot rather than guide you to eat well.

Herbs Against Bacterial Lung Infections (and this is where the established medical literature gets interesting):

Yersinia pestis has shown resistance to multiple antibiotics over the decades, including weaponized bacterial strains. (source)

That is precisely why broad-spectrum herbal antibiotics truly matter: Plants do not produce single-molecule drugs that bacteria can defeat with a single mutation. They produce complex cocktails of compounds that hit multiple targets at once, which is precisely why resistance develops far more slowly.

—Rhubarb (rheum species) is scientifically documented to downregulate Y. pestis genes involved in ribosome protein synthesis and transport binding, disrupting the bacterial envelope and protein synthesis through a dual action that is far less prone to resistance. (second source)(third source)(4th source)

Cao Shuji cites the traditional Chinese physician Li Jianshi who, in 1935, claimed success in treating bubonic plague with very high rhubarb doses (Cao 1995: 189; I have not so far been able to obtain Li’s book). Bio-medically trained physicians in China have been undertaking research on why rhubarb is effective against Y. pestis, apparently having already concluded that it is. (Bai et al. 2008). (source)

–Berberine-containing herbs — Goldenseal, Oregon grape, and Indian barberry — are potent against resistant bacterial pathogens.

Studies have shown that berberine alters the expression of 360 Y. pestis genes, which functions like a genetic hand grenade thrown into the bacterial command center. This is not folk wisdom. This is molecular biology, and the fact that you have never heard it from a corporate media outlet tells you everything about where their loyalties lie.

––Usnea lichen (usnic acid) inhibits Y. pestis and antibiotic-resistant organisms. Usnea is a free antibiotic that may grow in your backyard.

Also, mullein has a strong respiratory affinity and has been used for lungs for centuries. Red root stimulates lymph and immunity. Camphor and essential oils can help purify the air.

–Also keep garlic fermented in honey, oil of oregano, olive leaf extract, thyme, osha root, astragulus, essential oil of eucalyptus, mullein, ginger, licorice root (pairs well with mullein and usnea lichen, manuka honey mixed with turmeric for broader support.

All of these herbs listed have multiple attributes including being antiinflammatory, decongestant, expectorant, antioxidant, or immune boosting. All in some way help repair lung damage, combat infections, and boost overall respiratory function and are workhorses for bacterial and viral lung infections.

The Herbal Academy article THREE HERBAL ACTIONS FOR RESPIRATORY SUPPORT explains for laymen just how important they are. 

These are not substitutes for emergency care, and they are not a replacement for competent medical advice. Check with a naturopathic physician, and avoid contraindications during pregnancy. But understand this: the knowledge of how to fortify a human body against bacterial infection is thousands of years old, it is scientifically validated, and it has been systematically suppressed by an industry that cannot patent a plant.

Prepare, Don’t Panic

The answer is not fear. The answer is the marvelous and adaptive terrain given us by our Creator. Shore up your vitamin D, your vitamin C, your vitamin A, your zinc, your selenium, your protein, and your sleep. Keep herbs on hand if you choose — Rhubarb, berberine, usnea, mullein, red root. Use independent tools like BrightAnswers.ai to do your own research instead of waiting for permission from a corporate news anchor. Support natural health sources that tell you the truth even when it costs them advertising revenue.

Work with a naturopathic doctor who respects your autonomy. But do not let a manufactured plague scare rob you of your peace, your freedom, or your ability to think clearly. The bacteria are real. The fear is not. And the difference between those two things is the difference between living as a free person and living as a managed patient for the rest of your life.

articles.title: Keadilan TIDAK BISA DIBELI dengan AMAL.
articles.content:
Bayangkan pemilik dapur MBG korupsi 10M, hakim melepaskan orang tersebut karena dia memberikan santunan kepada 100 orang anak Yatim-Piatu. Adilkah?

Seseorang berhutang 150 jt kepada orang lain, lalu berkata “Saya tidak membayar hutang, tapi kan saya sering berbuat baik kepada orang lain”. Adilkah?

Lalu pikirkan seorang rohaniawan melakukan perzinahan dan dosa-dosa lainnya, lalu dia berpuasa selama sebulan. Menurut ajarannya puasanya ini dapat menghapus semua dosa-dosanya. Setelah puasa dia kembali suci seperti bayi. Adilkah? Adilkah? Adilkah? 🤔

Sang yang maha adil tidak mungkin tidak adil, karena Dialah KEADILAN. Keadilan menuntut setiap dosa/kejahatan HARUS dihukum. Jika dosa/kejahatan tidak dihukum, maka keadilan TIDAK ADA. Faktanya KEADILAN itu ada, karena itu dosa harus dihukum.

Masalahnya manusia “menciptakan Tuhan” yang tidak adil (dalam pikirannya) sehingga menghasilkan Tuhan yang DAPAT menukar dosa dengan AMAL. Tuhan yang bisa menukar dosa dengan puasa. Tuhan yang bisa menukar kejahatan dengan perbuatan baik.

Saya tanya ketukang pangkas “apakah adil jika seorang hakim melepaskan penjahat hanya karena penjahat itu melakukan amal”. Dia jawab, TIDAK ADIL. Lalu saya tanya lagi, apakah kejahatan boleh dilepaskan dengan berpuasa? Keadilan dalam hatinya “bertubrukan” dengan ajaran yang ia pegang sehingga dia jawab “Tidak TAHU”.

Sebenarnya dia tahu jawabannya, namun karena imannya, akal sehatnya “mampet”, dia tidak jujur. Padahal jika dia jujur terhadap kebenaran, kebenaran itu akan membebaskannya dari ajaran yang ia pegang.

Ada tertulis “Dosa adalah pelanggaran terhadap hukum Allah”. Dosa berada di bawah tuntutan keadilan Allah. Karena keadilan Allah itu nyata, maka dosa harus dihukum. Dosa yang HANYA diampuni tanpa dihukum adalah KETIDAKADILAN. Ketidakadilan tanpa hukuman seperti ini adalah hayalan ala pengadilan bayaran.

Lalu bagaimana manusia bisa diselamatkan?
Jawaban satu-satunya adalah Yesus Kristus TELAH menanggung hukuman atas dosa Anda dan saya. Hukuman itu tidak dihapus, tetapi dipindahkan kepada Kristus, seperti ada tertulis:

a. Dia sendiri telah memikul dosa kita di dalam tubuhNya di kayu salib (1 Petrus 2:24).

b. Dia yang tidak mengenal dosa telah dibuatNya menjadi dosa karena kita, supaya dalam Dia kita dibenarkan oleh Allah (2 Korintus 5:21).

c. Kristus telah mati untuk dosa-dosa kita, sesuai dengan Kitab Suci (1 Korintus 15:3).

Di salib keadilan Allah tetap ditegakkan, karena dosa HARUS dihukum. Kasih Allah TELAH dinyatakan, karena Yesus MENANGGUNG hukuman itu bagi kita.

Itulah sebabnya Injil adalah kabar baik dari Surga. Manusia tidak DAPAT menyelamatkan dirinya dengan amal, puasa, atau perbuatan baik, tetapi oleh PENGORBANAN Yesus Kristus di salib.

Gbl. Ranto V. Simamora

articles.title: Karena kasih karunia kamu diselamatkan oleh iman!
articles.content:
Efesus 2:8-9 (TB) Sebab karena kasih karunia kamu diselamatkan oleh iman; itu bukan hasil usahamu, tetapi pemberian Allah, itu bukan hasil pekerjaanmu: jangan ada orang yang memegahkan diri.

Bagaimana dengan Yakobus 2:24 Jadi kamu lihat, bahwa manusia dibenarkan karena perbuatan-perbuatannya dan bukan hanya karena iman.

Perhatikan Yakobus memulainya dengan kesimpulan di ayat 17 bahwa iman yang benar harus DISERTAI perbuatan nyata. Perbuatan inilah yang menunjukkan, memperlihatkan iman kita tidak kosong apalagi mati, tapi iman yang benar dan hidup.

Yakobus 2:17 Demikian juga halnya dengan iman: Jika iman itu tidak disertai perbuatan, maka iman itu pada hakekatnya adalah mati.
18Tetapi mungkin ada orang berkata: ”Padamu ada iman dan padaku ada perbuatan”, aku akan menjawab dia: ”Tunjukkanlah kepadaku imanmu itu tanpa perbuatan, dan aku akan menunjukkan kepadamu imanku dari perbuatan-perbuatanku.” 19Engkau percaya, bahwa hanya ada satu Allah saja? Itu baik! Tetapi setan-setan pun juga percaya akan hal itu dan mereka gemetar. 20 Hai manusia yang bebal, maukah engkau mengakui sekarang, bahwa iman tanpa perbuatan adalah iman yang kosong? 21 Bukankah Abraham, bapa kita, dibenarkan karena perbuatan-perbuatannya, ketika ia mempersembahkan Ishak, anaknya, di atas mezbah? 22 Kamu lihat, bahwa iman bekerjasama dengan perbuatan-perbuatan dan oleh perbuatan-perbuatan itu iman menjadi sempurna. 23 Dengan jalan demikian genaplah nas yang mengatakan: “Lalu percayalah Abraham kepada Allah, maka Allah memperhitungkan hal itu kepadanya sebagai kebenaran.” Karena itu Abraham disebut: “Sahabat Allah.”

Roma 4:9 Adakah ucapan bahagia ini hanya berlaku bagi orang bersunat saja atau juga bagi orang tak bersunat? Sebab telah kami katakan, bahwa kepada Abraham iman diperhitungkan sebagai kebenaran. 10Dalam keadaan manakah hal itu diperhitungkan? Sebelum atau sesudah ia disunat? Bukan sesudah disunat, tetapi sebelumnya.

Perhatikan! Abraham dibenarkan SEBELUM dia melakukan perintah sunat! Tapi dia tetap melakukan sunat itu walaupun SUDAH dibenarkan.
Jadi tanpa perbuatan, iman itu cuman “ngomong doank,” “asal bunyi.”
Contoh misal saya dikasihtau, “jangan pegang, ini besi panas, nanti tanganmu terbakar,” lalu saya bilang “ya saya percaya,” tapi lalu saya pegang juga besi itu. Terlihat disini mulut saya bilang percaya tapi sebenarnya itu iman kosong, mati. Perbuatan saya itu menunjukkan iman saya kosong dan mati.

Roma 3:27-28 (TB) Jika demikian, apakah dasarnya untuk bermegah? Tidak ada! Berdasarkan apa? Berdasarkan perbuatan? Tidak, melainkan berdasarkan iman!
Karena kami yakin, bahwa manusia dibenarkan karena iman, dan bukan karena ia melakukan hukum Taurat.

Roma 4:3, 6, 10 (TB) Sebab apakah dikatakan nas Kitab Suci? “Lalu percayalah Abraham kepada Tuhan, dan Tuhan memperhitungkan hal itu kepadanya sebagai kebenaran.”
Seperti juga Daud menyebut berbahagia orang yang dibenarkan Allah bukan berdasarkan perbuatannya:
Dalam keadaan manakah hal itu diperhitungkan? Sebelum atau sesudah ia disunat? Bukan sesudah disunat, tetapi sebelumnya.

Roma 5:1 (TB) Sebab itu, kita yang dibenarkan karena iman, kita hidup dalam damai sejahtera dengan Allah oleh karena Tuhan kita, Yesus Kristus.

Roma 9:31-32 (TB) Tetapi: bahwa Israel, sungguhpun mengejar hukum yang akan mendatangkan kebenaran, tidaklah sampai kepada hukum itu. Mengapa tidak? Karena Israel mengejarnya bukan karena iman, tetapi karena perbuatan. Mereka tersandung pada batu sandungan,

Roma 10:9-10 (TB) Sebab jika kamu mengaku dengan mulutmu, bahwa Yesus adalah Tuhan, dan percaya dalam hatimu, bahwa Allah telah membangkitkan Dia dari antara orang mati, maka kamu akan diselamatkan. Karena dengan hati orang percaya dan dibenarkan, dan dengan mulut orang mengaku dan diselamatkan.

Roma 11:6 Tetapi jika hal itu terjadi karena kasih karunia, maka bukan lagi karena perbuatan, sebab jika tidak demikian, maka kasih karunia itu bukan lagi kasih karunia.

Galatia 2:16 (TB) Kamu tahu, bahwa tidak seorang pun yang dibenarkan oleh karena melakukan hukum Taurat, tetapi hanya oleh karena iman dalam Kristus Yesus. Sebab itu kami pun telah percaya kepada Kristus Yesus, supaya kami dibenarkan oleh karena iman dalam Kristus dan bukan oleh karena melakukan hukum Taurat. Sebab: “tidak ada seorang pun yang dibenarkan” oleh karena melakukan hukum Taurat.

Galatia 3:10-11 (TB) Karena semua orang, yang hidup dari pekerjaan hukum Taurat, berada di bawah kutuk. Sebab ada tertulis: “Terkutuklah orang yang tidak setia melakukan segala sesuatu yang tertulis dalam kitab hukum Taurat.”
Dan bahwa tidak ada orang yang dibenarkan di hadapan Allah karena melakukan hukum Taurat adalah jelas, karena: “Orang yang benar akan hidup oleh iman.”

2 Timotius 1:9
Dialah yang menyelamatkan kita dan memanggil kita dengan panggilan kudus, bukan berdasarkan perbuatan kita, melainkan berdasarkan maksud dan kasih karunia-Nya sendiri, yang telah dikaruniakan kepada kita dalam Kristus Yesus sebelum permulaan zaman

Titus 3:5
pada waktu itu Dia telah menyelamatkan kita, bukan karena perbuatan baik yang telah kita lakukan, tetapi karena rahmat-Nya oleh permandian kelahiran kembali dan oleh pembaharuan yang dikerjakan oleh Roh Kudus,

Tetaplah berpegang teguh pada iman yang menyelamatkan dan jangan pernah mundur meninggalkan iman yang benar ini.

Ibrani 10:38 (TB) Tetapi orang-Ku yang benar akan hidup oleh iman, dan apabila ia mengundurkan diri, maka Aku tidak berkenan kepadanya.”
